description: This file contains the ArnParser class, which provides functionality to parse AWS ARN strings and instantiate specific ARN objects based on the parsed data. It includes methods for detecting ARNs and parsing ARN strings into their component objects.

classes.name: ArnParser
classes.description: A static class providing methods to parse AWS ARN strings into specific ARN object instances, such as S3 access points, Outposts, or multi-region access points.

methods.name: isArn
methods.description: Checks if a given string is an ARN by verifying if it starts with 'arn:'.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an ARN string and returns an instance of an ARN subclass depending on its components, such as ObjectLambdaAccessPointArn, OutpostsBucketArn, etc.

methods.name: explodeResourceComponent
methods.description: Splits the resource part of the ARN string into its components based on '/' or ':' delimiters.
